import sys,json,subprocess,shutil
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now

state=read_json(statep);pub=read_json(pubp)
assert state['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation_no_image_replay' and state['last_checkpoint_requests']==0 and pub['commit']==commit
assert not (statep.parent/'publisher.lock').exists()
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261026-v18-first-lock-timeout-rebase-recovery2.json';assert not target.exists()
saved=[]
for source,name in [(statep,'publisher-state'),(pubp,'publication')]:
 dest=target.with_name(target.stem+'-'+name+'.json')
 with dest.open('xb') as f:f.write(source.read_bytes())
 assert file_sha256(dest)==file_sha256(source)
 saved.append({'path':dest.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(dest)})
record={'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'private_validated_commit':commit,'batch':batch,'original_deadline_utc_unchanged':state['original_deadline_utc'],'preserved_failed_receipts':saved,'scope':'Git-only recovery. No primary checkout/index replacement, public-history rewrite, image replay, prompt change or deadline extension.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
write_json(target,record)
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-X','utf8','tools/isolated_production_sync.py',commit,'resumed-low-v18-auto-1-20261025-recovery2'],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=600)
out=ROOT/'runtime/v18-first-recovery2-isolated-result-20261026.json';assert not out.exists()
write_json(out,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr,'history':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'history_sha256':file_sha256(target),'image_calls':0})
print(json.dumps({'actual_isolated_helper_exit_code':p.returncode,'result':out.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'stdout':p.stdout[-1500:],'stderr':p.stderr[-2500:]},ensure_ascii=True),flush=True)
